learning_outcomes.text: Classifies active forces and moments of mechanical systems.
Calculates the basic parameters of machine dynamics problems.
Derives the equations of motion for mechanical systems.

syllabus_topics: Degrees of freedom and Generalized Coordinates; Unit systems and Vectors
Undamped Vibrations; Motion in two dimensions
Damped Vibrations; Motion in two dimensions
Principle of Virtual Work, D'Alembert's Principle in Lagrangian form and its applications
Equivalent masses theory, Reduction of mass and moment of inertia in machines
Second fundamental problem of dynamics - calculation of driving force/moment
First fundamental problem of dynamics - calculation of acceleration
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated from 40% in-term achievement and 60% final exam. In-term achievement is based on a midterm exam (70%), one assignment (10%), and two quizzes (10% each).
